roles.title: PhD Students
roles.text: We are recruiting PhD students interested in wearable systems, mobile sensing, and AI for health and accessibility. Background in systems, machine learning, signal processing, or hardware prototyping is welcome.
roles.subject: [UTD PhD] Your Name

roles.title: UTD MS Students
roles.text: Current UT Dallas master's students interested in research or a thesis are welcome to reach out. Please include your transcript and any relevant project experience.
roles.subject: [UTD MS] Your Name

roles.title: UTD Undergraduates
roles.text: UT Dallas undergraduates who are curious about research are encouraged to get involved, for example through independent study or senior projects. No prior research experience is required.
roles.subject: [UTD Undergrad] Your Name
